description: Personal perfume and cologne recommendations from taste: fragrances they love or dislike, notes they like or avoid, plus gender, season, occasion, style and family. Every pick says why (shared notes with a loved perfume, a liked note, fits the season). Use when someone says what they enjoy or avoid and wants suggestions ('I love Delina and vanilla, nothing too sweet, for winter evenings', 'my signature scent is Sauvage, what next'). Not for one-off filters without taste (use search_perfumes), not for a single occasion list (use pick_for_occasion) and not for gifts (use find_gift).

dislikes.description: Perfumes they dislike; similar ones are pushed down

family.description: A fragrance family or word like "woody" or "citrus"

gender.description: Audience the perfume is marketed to. men and women also include unisex perfumes.

likes.description: Perfumes they love, e.g. ["Parfums de Marly Delina","Dior Sauvage"]

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).

season.description: Season the perfume suits (fall is accepted in text queries as autumn).

items.description: A style word the scent should have.

name: recommend_perfumes
title: Recommend perfumes
